verdict.rationale: Zamzar's pricing page documents the maximum file size for each plan (1MB, 50MB, Unlimited, Unlimited), so developers can size jobs by file size. The only duration-related item is the SDK's default 60-second wait timeout, which is a client polling default rather than a documented processing-duration limit. Nothing in the evidence covers concurrency limits. Missing for 10: documented conversion duration/processing-time limits, documented concurrency or parallel-job limits, independent corroboration of the limits.
